% Velocity magnitude in the skewed box (run/skewedBox/schemes_10steps) at t = 0.1 s (10 time steps).

\newcommand{\rowlabel}[1]{%
  \begin{minipage}[c]{0.035\linewidth}
    \centering
    \rotatebox[origin=c]{90}{\textbf{#1}}
  \end{minipage}}
\newcommand{\panel}[2]{%
  \begin{minipage}[c]{0.32\linewidth}
    \centering
    {\small\textbf{#1}}\\[1pt]
    \includegraphics[width=\linewidth]{../../../run/skewedBox/schemes_10steps/#2/#2.png}
  \end{minipage}}
